sections.title: Snapshot
sections.content: Snapshot time: 2026-10-29 17:48 UTC; scope: Daily; date range: 2026-10-29 through 2026-10-29; first 10 ranked by daily Trending star gains, with two recent repository supplements.

sections.title: Headline
sections.content: AI coding-agent infrastructure dominates today's GitHub momentum: design-quality controls, durable context, agent workspaces, and repeatable engineering workflows account for most of the ranked repos. Personalized tutoring and document OCR provide notable non-coding-agent counterpoints; two projects created within the last two days add fresh signals beyond the Trending list.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content:
- **Agentic engineering workflows:** Reusable skills and checklists, IDE workflows, and role-based project systems package engineering practice around coding agents. Supporting repositories: 04-elayadesign-ai-design-skills, 05-jetbrains-thinkrail, 06-obra-superpowers, 08-donchitos-claude-code-game-studios, 12-minimax-ai-mcode-stack.
- **Agent IDEs and persistent workspaces:** Several projects move beyond one-shot chat toward isolated work, persistent teammates, computer access, and governance. Supporting repositories: 03-milind-soni-openmausbot, 05-jetbrains-thinkrail, 07-nightly-labs-openbot, 10-copilotkit-openbot.
- **Design quality for AI-built interfaces:** Impeccable and AI Design Skills emphasize explicit design direction and repeatable evaluation rather than generic code generation. Supporting repositories: 01-pbakaus-impeccable, 04-elayadesign-ai-design-skills.
- **Persistent context:** Claude Mem treats cross-session memory as agent infrastructure, while DeepTutor reuses learner context across educational workflows. Supporting repositories: 02-hkuds-deeptutor, 09-thedotmack-claude-mem.
- **Personalized AI learning:** DeepTutor unifies tutoring, research, problem solving, quizzes, and mastery practice in a learning workspace. Supporting repositories: 02-hkuds-deeptutor.
- **Document intelligence beyond code:** MiniCPM-OCR combines document parsing with a correctness-scoring model for OCR results. Supporting repositories: 11-openbmb-minicpm-ocr.
- **Languages:** TypeScript leads the listed set (6 repositories), followed by Python (2) and Shell (2); Rust appears once, and one repo has no primary language reported by GitHub.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: The most visible trend is not merely “more coding agents,” but an emerging support layer around them: repeatable workflows, lasting project context, safer computer access, and design/review quality controls. Today's fastest-growing list is heavily AI-tooling-centered, while tutoring and document OCR show that the same agent and model infrastructure is spreading into learning and information processing. The two extra new-repository signals are ranked separately from Trending because GitHub Search does not provide their daily star gains.
